title: Kingdom Quiz
tagline: A host-led Bible trivia game for church game nights.
description: Turn a laptop and a projector into a quiz-show stage. One person hosts on the big screen while up to four players take turns answering, and everyone else joins from their own phone with a four-letter code to vote when a player asks the audience. 600 Bible questions and 150 Church History questions.
features: 750 questions, each answer followed by the full KJV verse
50:50, Phone a Friend and a live Ask the Audience vote
Audience joins from their phones with a room code
Works offline after the first visit (voting needs a connection)
